class.name: NNHTNTask
class.brief_description: A primitive HTN action executed as a step in a plan.
class.description: Defines an executable action in an HTN domain along with the blackboard [member effects] it predicts during planning and commits on success. Implement the action by overriding [method on_execute] (and optionally [method on_cancel]), or place a child AI root ([NNBTRoot], [NNSTRoot], [NNHTNRoot], or [NNAgent]) under this task to host it while the step runs. Store per-step runtime state in [member NNHTNPlanStep.runtime] rather than on the task node so the same template can be reused via [NNHTNSubtaskCall]. Optionally configure [member verification_mode] to wait for observed [member postconditions] before committing effects, [member runtime_effect_commit_mode] to let sensors own certain keys, [member resumable] to avoid restarting when a replan keeps the same first step, and concurrency properties when used inside an [NNHTNParallelTask].

method.name: on_can_continue_verification
method.description: Optional hook checked before each verification tick in [constant VERIFY] mode. Return [code]false[/code] to abort verification with [code]"verification_unsafe"[/code].

method.name: on_cancel
method.description: Optional hook called once when a running or verifying [param step] is abandoned (replaced by a new plan, invalidated, or disabled). Clean up actor-side actions here.

method.name: on_execute
method.description: Override to perform the task each tick, returning [constant RUNNING], [constant SUCCESS], or [constant FAILURE]. Optional if this task hosts a child AI root instead.

method.name: on_get_effects
method.description: Optional planning hook returning dynamic predicted effects based on [param state] and [param args]. Overrides [member effects].

method.name: on_get_estimated_cost
method.description: Optional planning hook returning a dynamic non-negative cost under [constant NNHTNSearchSettings.LOWEST_COST]. Overrides [member estimated_cost].

method.name: on_verify
method.description: Optional hook in [constant VERIFY] mode to confirm the action took effect against the live blackboard before committing effects. Defaults to checking [member postconditions].

members.member: Exclusive actor resources used while running (such as [code]"locomotion"[/code] or [code]"hands"[/code]), checked by [NNHTNParallelTask] during planning to prevent conflicting branches.
Must be [code]true[/code] for this task to run concurrently inside an [NNHTNParallelTask], confirming its resources and read/write keys are fully declared.
Additional blackboard keys read during execution (beyond conditions, dependency keys, and postconditions), used by [NNHTNParallelTask] conflict checking.
Additional blackboard keys written during execution (beyond declared effects), used by [NNHTNParallelTask] conflict checking.
Blackboard key/value updates predicted during planning and committed on success. A [code]null[/code] value clears the key. Ignored if [method on_get_effects] is overridden.
Non-negative estimated cost used by [constant NNHTNSearchSettings.LOWEST_COST]. Ignored if [method on_get_estimated_cost] is overridden.
Conditions evaluated against the live blackboard in [constant VERIFY] mode before committing effects.
If [code]true[/code], keeps the running occurrence intact (without cancelling or restarting) when a replan produces a new plan starting with the exact same step.
Subset of effect keys written to the blackboard on success when [member runtime_effect_commit_mode] is [constant ALLOWLIST].
Controls which predicted effects are written to the blackboard on success ([constant ALL], [constant NONE], or [constant ALLOWLIST]). Planning always predicts all effects.
Whether [constant SUCCESS] from [method on_execute] commits effects immediately ([constant TRUST_SUCCESS]) or waits for [method on_verify] / [member postconditions] first ([constant VERIFY]).
Maximum seconds to wait for verification in [constant VERIFY] mode before failing with [code]"verification_timeout"[/code]. [code]0.0[/code] allows one immediate check.

signal.name: failed
signal.description: Emitted when a started occurrence fails, fails verification, fails to commit effects, or is invalidated.

signal.name: started
signal.description: Emitted when an occurrence starts executing.

signal.name: succeeded
signal.description: Emitted when an occurrence succeeds and commits its effects.

constants.constant: The step failed and ends the plan.
The step is still in progress and will be ticked again.
Commits effects immediately when [method on_execute] returns [constant SUCCESS].
Waits for [method on_verify] (or [member postconditions]) to confirm the outcome before committing effects.
Writes all predicted effects to the blackboard on success.
Writes no effects on success (expecting sensors to observe the changes instead).
Writes only the effect keys listed in [member runtime_commit_effect_keys].
